notes: Split-screen hardening for The Library. Reduces the minimum supported window size from 520x420 to 420x360, switches to the compact layout sooner, and keeps all Library work tabs scrollable while resized. Portable Backup/Restore from v1.0.3 is preserved because this update patches the current installed source rather than replacing user data. Windows PowerShell parsing and payload/internal SHA-256 validation passed before publish.
